title: Engine performance and check engine light
summary: This topic combines praise for engine performance with reports of check-engine-light events and a few explicit starting or fault complaints.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the engine as powerful, satisfying, or generally impressive.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe check-engine faults or an engine that failed to start, but the examples are limited.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly note that the check engine light came on or required service without enough detail to judge the owner's sentiment.

signal_notes.interpretation: The exploratory signal indicates BEVE examples in this topic are more often tagged negative or mixed than the rest of the engine-type breakdown, based on a small set of reviewed examples.

limitations: This cluster mixes two related but distinct subjects: general engine praise and check-engine-light incidents.
Most undetermined examples only state that a check engine light appeared, so the sample often lacks detail about severity, diagnosis, repair outcome, or owner sentiment.
The supplied examples are limited and stratified rather than representative, so they should not be used to infer broader defect rates or prevalence.
